fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of change set 01M6MYFH4QYGSKDATBH509SEJF (A milestone request launches an interactive planning session). The planner read internal/api/request.go (daemonPlanRequests starts requests only while running < max, oldest first, held by the usage governor), internal/api/inbox.go (a non-autonomous run's question item appears only once an AskUserQuestion blocks) and internal/api/daemon.go (daemonNotify). The daemon already starts a milestone request's plan run and its interview opens a Rex tab; what is missing is starting it at once and telling the owner at launch. Three questions (start timing, notification, usage hold) went to the arbiter, which answered with Decision milestone-interview-starts-at-once: start at the next poll ahead of every request and past run slots, one milestone interview live at a time; waiting status at launch plus an inbox item from launch until the run ends; not held by a usage-reserve hold, still held by pause and disk-low. The never-autonomous part is the sibling change set 01M6MY8BMPFK9ZWD3TDQHKT64J. The change set serves milestone-25. No owner was present, so no owner words are quoted.
fields.title: Planning the milestone-request launch, autonomous run
